claims.text: Various baselines were tested, including a majority-class baseline and a No-answer baseline, which were compared with the neural baseline.
The neural baseline (Bert + Unanswerable) was evaluated against other baselines, showing its performance relative to them.
The results indicate that the neural baseline underperforms compared to human performance, suggesting the need for further improvements.
